Mumbai FDA suspends 7 food outlets for hygiene violations

Mumbai's Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the licenses of seven food establishments in the city. The action was taken following inspections that revealed severe hygiene violations, including the presence of cockroaches, flies, and the use of "fake cheese." The FDA's crackdown targeted kitchens found to be in a filthy condition.
